vulnerability.name: GHSA-2v4p-qf9q-27wj
vulnerability.description: CVE-2026-84445: denial of service in gRPC-Go xDS servers.

statements.impact_statement: Reviewed the linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 controller v0.2.0 platform manifests identified in products. The /manager binaries embed google.golang.org/grpc v1.83.1 through outbound OpenTelemetry trace export. Neither binary contains google.golang.org/grpc/xds server symbols. The release source does not instantiate xds.NewGRPCServer, and its ./cmd dependency graph excludes google.golang.org/grpc/xds. The vulnerable xDS server routing interceptor is not present. govulncheck v1.6.0 source analysis reports this advisory at module/package level without a reachable vulnerable symbol.

vulnerability.name: GO-2026-6860
vulnerability.description: CVE-2026-78661: quadratic complexity in golang.org/x/net/html tree parsing.

statements.impact_statement: Reviewed the linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 controller v0.2.0 platform manifests identified in products. The /manager binaries embed golang.org/x/net v0.61.0. Neither binary contains html.Parse, html.ParseFragment, html.ParseWithOptions, or html.ParseFragmentWithOptions symbols. The release source imports html only through html/charset via Gomega matchers; charset uses html.NewTokenizer, not the affected tree-construction functions. govulncheck v1.6.0 source analysis reports this advisory at module/package level without a reachable vulnerable symbol.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-97043
vulnerability.description: GO-2026-6848: Escaped quotes in cgo linker directives in Go build tools.

statements.impact_statement: This advisory affects cmd/go and cmd/compile while building malicious packages. Reviewed the linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 controller v0.2.0 platform manifests identified in products. The final image copies /manager and license files into distroless/static:nonroot; it does not ship the Go compiler or go command and does not compile packages at runtime. Both extracted /manager binaries report CGO_ENABLED=0. The embedded Go 1.26.10 build version explains the scanner match but does not include the affected build-tool implementation in the runtime image. This disposition covers the shipped images only; upgrading the builder separately addresses build-environment exposure.

vulnerability.name: GO-2026-6859
vulnerability.description: CVE-2026-97054: concurrent HTTP/1 response-header access when a MaxBytesReader body limit is exceeded.

statements.impact_statement: Reviewed the linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 controller v0.2.0 manifests identified in products. The net/http maxBytesReader.Read implementation is present, so this is not a code-absence disposition. The affected behavior requires exceeding a MaxBytesReader limit while the handler reads the request body concurrently with response-header writes. The controller-runtime v0.25.2 admission webhook reads its body synchronously through io.LimitedReader before writing a response. Inspection of the controller dependency closure found no non-standard-library references to MaxBytesReader or MaxBytesHandler. The remaining net/http OPTIONS * path sets its header and drains a limited body synchronously in the request handler. No triggering concurrent body-read/header-write execution path was identified. Generic reachable net/http symbols reported by govulncheck do not establish this required concurrency pattern.

vulnerability.name: GO-2026-6866
vulnerability.description: CVE-2026-97045: incorrect foreign-namespace handling in golang.org/x/net/html rendering.

statements.impact_statement: Reviewed the linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 controller v0.2.0 manifests identified in products. Neither extracted /manager binary contains golang.org/x/net/html.Render or childTextNodesAreLiteral symbols. The release source imports html through html/charset via Gomega matchers; charset uses html.NewTokenizer rather than rendering HTML trees. govulncheck v1.6.0 source and binary analysis report module/package presence without an affected Render symbol. The vulnerable rendering implementation is absent from the shipped binaries.

vulnerability.name: GO-2026-6975
vulnerability.description: GHSA-rrfc-gjm9-cgrj: bounded memory-allocation amplification in OpenTelemetry W3C baggage parsing.

statements.impact_statement: Reviewed the linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 controller v0.2.0 manifests identified in products. internal/telemetry/tracing.go explicitly installs propagation.TraceContext{} and does not enable propagation.Baggage. Its HTTP instrumentation wraps an outbound transport. Neither extracted /manager binary contains baggage.Parse or propagation.Baggage.Extract symbols, and govulncheck v1.6.0 reports no reachable affected parsing symbol. The upstream trigger requires parsing attacker-controlled W3C baggage, which the reviewed controller configuration does not do. Re-review this disposition if baggage propagation or extraction is introduced.
